Dental Coverage Under Medicare
Medicare is a federal health insurance program for people 65 and older and for people under 65 with specific disabilities. Medicare only covers dental services related to certain medical conditions or treatments. It does not cover dentures or most routine care like checkups, cleanings, or fillings. Visit Medicare Dental Services or call 1–800–MEDICARE (1–800–633–4227). Have your Medicare number handy when you call.

programs.title: Dental Care for Children Up to 19 Years

How to Legally Get Money from Your Congressman
programs.text:
The office of your elected officials can be the best place to turn to get free help. They are in the best position to be aware of the free help and services that are available in your community as well as the state or national level. Your representatives also have the most power to help and have the biggest motive to help.
Their Power… The government bureaucracy that provides money and services to the community relies on the elected officials for their money. You may pay the taxes, but it is the elected officials who “control the purse strings” and determine the budgets and salaries for government bureaucrats. These government agencies have special back door phone numbers to handle requests from elected officials while you and I have to wait in line at the front door.
Their Motive... Elected officials WANT to help you because if they are able to make a phone call and get you the help you need, you will vote for this official no matter how many sex scandals they have.
